def choose_move(observation):
    # Defensive access to observation fields with default values
    me = observation.get('player', {})
    my_x = me.get('x', 0)
    my_y = me.get('y', 0)
    
    # Determine opponent(s) position
    opponents = observation.get('opponents', [])
    if opponents:
        opp = opponents[0]
        opp_x = opp.get('x', 0)
        opp_y = opp.get('y', 0)
    else:
        opp_x, opp_y = my_x, my_y

    # Determine resource positions if available
    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    if resources:
        # Pick the closest resource
        res_dist = [(abs(r.get('x', 0)-my_x)+abs(r.get('y', 0)-my_y), r) for r in resources]
        _, target_resource = min(res_dist, key=lambda t: t[0])
        target_x = target_resource.get('x', my_x)
        target_y = target_resource.get('y', my_y)
    else:
        # No resources known, move toward opponent or stay put
        target_x, target_y = opp_x, opp_y

    dx = 0
    dy = 0

    # Move horizontally toward target
    if target_x > my_x:
        dx = 1
    elif target_x < my_x:
        dx = -1
    
    # Move vertically toward target
    if target_y > my_y:
        dy = 1
    elif target_y < my_y:
        dy = -1

    # Limit movement to -1, 0, 1
    if dx not in {-1,0,1}:
        dx = 0
    if dy not in {-1,0,1}:
        dy = 0

    return [dx, dy]
